items.front: In IAM, an application on EC2 instances must call AWS APIs without a stored key. What do you use?
items.back: An IAM role through an instance profile.
items.extra: [AWS delivers the temporary credentials of an IAM role to that compute resource](../facts/iam.md#iam-compute-services-receive-role-credentials-no-keys-needed).

items.front: In IAM, SCP or permissions boundary: which one limits the root user of a member account?
items.extra: An SCP limits principals [including the member account's root user](../facts/iam.md#iam-scp-applies-to-member-root-user); you [cannot set a permissions boundary for the root user](../facts/iam.md#iam-root-user-no-identity-policies-or-boundary).

items.front: In IAM, an AssumeRole session without DurationSeconds lasts {{c1::one hour}}.
In IAM, can a bucket policy name an IAM group as its principal?
items.back: No. Name a role or a user instead.
items.extra: You [cannot identify a user group as a principal](../facts/iam.md#iam-principal-group-cannot-be-principal).
